description: This file defines the ProjectReport class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It implements report generation functionalities related to projects, including preparing filter parameters, validation rules, header and filter definitions, data retrieval, and access control. The class interacts with request parameters, validation rules, report data, and permissions, indicating it is a core component for generating project-related reports in the system.

classes.name: ProjectReport
classes.description: A class responsible for generating project-related reports, managing filters, validation, headers, data retrieval, and permission checks within the OrangeHRM platform. Implements the EndpointAwareReport interface.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters for the report based on request query parameters, including project ID, date range, and include timesheet flag.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for query parameters such as project ID and date filters, including existence and date validation.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header configuration for the report, including column names and properties.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Provides the filter configuration for the report, currently returning an empty filter.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters, returning an instance of ProjectReportData.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the report; throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.
